key_insight: TEMPLAR uses an agentic, template-centric framework to automatically induce and then continually refine standardized radiology reporting templates from large clinical corpora.
clinical_relevance: This could help hospitals create more consistent radiology reports that better preserve findings, improve structuring, and support diagnosis-related reasoning across sites.
method: Induction Agent clusters anatomy-constrained span-triple atoms into canonical clinical slots.
Evolution Agent assembles slots into a hierarchical template and revises it using consistency checks, external evidence, and downstream feedback.
Clinical Agent applies the evolved template for report structuring, reconstruction, and diagnostic reasoning.
evidence_signal: Across four datasets, TEMPLAR outperformed ASTAR and multiple medical/general LLMs on coverage, information fidelity, and diagnostic fidelity, with strong cross-dataset transfer.
watch_item: Results depend on large curated corpora and provenance-aware knowledge graphs, so deployment may require substantial data integration and validation before use in new settings.
paper_title: templar: agentic induction and evolution of standardized radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora
